I703.summary_en: Screens for depression in 166 college students using Fitbit physiological data and depression screening surveys collected during the COVID-19 pandemic, with multiple machine learning models. The best model reaches an F1-score of 0.92.

I704.screening_reason: Text data without an explicit student population
I704.summary_en: Compares traditional ML models and transformers (DistilBERT) for depression detection on 7,731 texts, motivated by depression among university students, and adds explainable AI. XGBoost achieves precision near 99% and recall of 98.6% for the depression class.

I705.screening_reason: Mixed population: college students and professionals
I705.summary_en: Identifies people mentally affected by the COVID-19 pandemic using a survey of college students and professionals and classifiers (Naive Bayes, KNN, RF, logistic regression, SVM). SVM obtains the highest accuracy (99.35%).

I706.screening_reason: Data from individuals' blogs, not specifically students
I706.summary_en: Motivated by youth and student suicide in India, classifies emotions from individuals' daily blogs and texts with a combination of classifiers. The ensemble outperforms individual classifiers, but no metrics are reported.

I707.summary_en: Proposes an IoT system that detects students' stress during tests with galvanic skin response sensors, clustering and machine learning to adapt reading materials. No sample size or quantitative results are reported.

I708.screening_reason: Outcome is academic grades and diabetes, not mental health
I708.summary_en: Uses public data on adolescent school students to predict final Portuguese grades considering alcohol consumption, and also proposes a diabetes prediction model. No results are reported.

I709.summary_en: Predicts stress in higher education faculty from text data using TF-IDF and a hybrid CNN-LSTM model. It achieves an average accuracy of 93.50%, outperforming standalone CNN and LSTM.

I710.screening_reason: Alopecia detection, not student mental health
I710.summary_en: Detects male alopecia patterns with computer vision (ORB, K-means, PCA) and classifiers on a Daegu University hair image dataset. KNN reaches 81% and SVM 78%.

I711.summary_en: Proposes a deep learning facial emotion recognition system to detect six emotions of students in real time during lectures, using facial images collected in class. No sample size or metrics are reported.

I712.screening_reason: General review of depression detection, not focused on students
I712.summary_en: Systematic review of machine learning and deep learning approaches for automated depression detection, mentioning students as an affected group. It discusses advantages and disadvantages of techniques without quantitative results.

I713.screening_reason: Population: medical and nursing staff, not students
I713.summary_en: Designs a psychological health evaluation system for medical and nursing staff based on an improved decision tree algorithm. Only technical improvements of the algorithm are reported.

I714.summary_en: Develops automated ADHD pre-screening in 506 university students combining psychometric instruments (ASRS, BAI, BDI-II, AAS) with NLP features from free-text self-reports, feature selection and five classifiers. Logistic regression performs best (81.4%, AUC 0.881) and SHAP highlights somatic anxiety, inattention and prior mental health history.

I715.summary_en: Proposes an LSTM model with feature-level fusion of multimodal learning analytics and an attention mechanism for real-time prediction of students' psychological states. It reaches 89.7% accuracy and F1 0.872, without describing the data.

I716.summary_en: Applies data mining, causal discovery and machine learning to EEG of depressed patients to predict antidepressant treatment response. Preliminary results are presented without metrics.

I717.summary_en: Predicts anxiety (SCARED questionnaire) in 417 O/L students from the Elpitiya Educational Zone with machine learning; 61.3% show some level of anxiety. Random Forest performs best (63.33%) and key factors include gender, BMI, screen time, physical activity, sleep and academic stress.

I718.screening_reason: Focus on the IBM Watson platform; target variable ambiguous (stress or grade)
I718.summary_en: Assesses the IBM Watson platform for building ML models through a case study of academic stress in university students surveyed after the COVID-19 peak. Random Forest reaches 66.4%; cognitive performance, self-study hours and absences predict the average score.

I719.screening_reason: Abstract without concrete data or results
I719.summary_en: Investigates deep learning-based psychological stress recognition algorithms for university students. It claims higher efficiency without describing data or reporting metrics.

I720.summary_en: Evaluates federated learning for loneliness detection from smartphone sensor data, compared with a centralized approach. It concludes the approach is promising while preserving privacy, without metrics.

I721.summary_en: Predicts suicidal ideation from a labelled dataset with several models (RF, LR, SVM, DT, MLP). Logistic regression performs best (76%).

I722.summary_en: Studies academic stress and incivility in college students using psychometric assessments and a hybrid SAE-LSTM classification model; 65% of students report depression. SAE-LSTM classifies mental health disorders with 96.67% accuracy, though the sample is not described.

I723.screening_reason: Evaluation of ideological and political courses, not mental health
I723.summary_en: Proposes an ensemble of BiLSTM and machine learning to analyze sentiment in teaching evaluations of ideological and political courses using the OULAD dataset. It reaches 98.4% accuracy.

I724.screening_reason: Educational platform; the mental health analytics component is marginal and not evaluated
I724.summary_en: Describes Able Vista, a web platform for specially abled teenage students offering learning resources and emotional self-checking with text classification models. No data or evaluation are reported.

I725.summary_en: Proposes a conceptual multimodal system for depression diagnosis combining text sentiment analysis and facial features. No data or metrics are reported.

I726.screening_reason: Physical education teaching, not mental health
I726.summary_en: Proposes a simulation method for physical education teaching using virtual reality and reinforcement learning. It reports improvements in skills and interest without metrics.

I727.screening_reason: Malay sentiment lexicon, not about students
I727.summary_en: Develops MySentiMentH, a lexicon of affective norms for Malay words in the mental health context to analyze emotions in social media. It demonstrates feasibility without metrics.

I728.summary_en: Proposes non-intrusive monitoring of pre-primary children's emotional development through image-based emotion recognition with transfer learning. No data or metrics are reported.

I729.screening_reason: Focus on the learning process; well-being is a secondary component
I729.summary_en: Describes a smart blended learning model for Education 4.0 integrating AI, IoT and wearable biofeedback to account for students' emotional states, stress and well-being. No quantitative results are reported.

I730.summary_en: Develops VR-based silent reading and Rosenberg self-esteem tests with 40 Italian university students with and without specific learning disorders, analyzed with machine learning. SVM is effective in identifying dyslexic tendencies and self-esteem is highlighted as relevant to well-being.

I731.screening_reason: Personality traits and learning strategies, not mental health
I731.summary_en: Predicts OCEAN personality traits from an open questionnaire with classifiers to recommend learning strategies. No metrics are reported.

I732.screening_reason: Bibliometric analysis of virtual teams, not students
I732.summary_en: Analyzes 400 Web of Science papers on virtual teams in the big data context with CiteSpace. It identifies eight thematic clusters, including well-being.

I733.screening_reason: General review of stress detection, not focused on students
I733.summary_en: Reviews 25 studies (2019-2025) on stress detection from physiological signals (EDA, ECG, PPG) with computational methods. It summarizes datasets, signals, metrics and validation gaps.

I734.best_result: Decision tree (GridSearchCV) accuracy 87% on training, 46-47% on test
I734.summary_en: Classifies university students' stress levels from text using TF-IDF, SMOTE and a decision tree tuned with GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV. GridSearchCV reaches 87% on training data but drops to 46-47% on validation and test data, indicating overfitting.

I735.screening_reason: Twitter data without an explicit student population
I735.summary_en: Motivated by the effect of social media on the mental health of adolescents and students, detects emotions through Twitter sentiment analysis with a boosted approach. Accuracy ranges between 88% and 92%.

I736.screening_reason: Smoking as a health behavior; link to mental health is partial
I736.summary_en: Predicts students' smoking propensity from demographic, socioeconomic, academic and lifestyle data with regression models (linear, Ridge, Lasso, decision tree). No results are reported.

I737.summary_en: Predicts stress and work-life balance of higher education teachers from workload, teaching hours and self-reported stress with a dense and LSTM model. It reaches 96.7% accuracy and F1 0.95.

I738.summary_en: Identifies predictors of academic performance from social skills in 93 psychology students using KDD and Random Forest. Gender and skills such as saying no and expressing disagreement are the main predictors.

I739.screening_reason: Gamified financial literacy, not mental health
I739.summary_en: Examines gamified financial literacy supported by AI, machine learning and augmented reality. No data or results are described.

I740.summary_en: Systematic review of 76 articles (2014-2024) on machine learning and deep learning in geriatric care for chronic diseases. Random Forest, logistic regression and CNN are the most used techniques.

I741.summary_en: Develops a facial emotion recognition system using computer vision and machine learning to detect mental stress in university students and support counseling departments. No data or metrics are reported.

I742.screening_reason: Population: police academy cadets; student status is partial
I742.best_result: XGBoost and TensorFlow neural network (highest accuracy)
I742.summary_en: Presents a real-time stress prediction framework for police training cadets using Fitbit and smartphone data (heart rate and self-reported stress), testing models on cloud and edge. XGBoost and a neural network achieve the highest accuracy and edge prediction reduces latency.

I743.screening_reason: Personalized learning platform; mental health not assessed
I743.summary_en: Describes an educational platform using NLP, sentiment analysis and gamification to adapt instruction to each student's cognitive and emotional state. Preliminary tests suggest improved outcomes and satisfaction without metrics.

I744.summary_en: Studies students' mental stress-handling capability during online exams over a 13-week semester, relating it to body composition and mental activity. An SVM model predicts this capability with high accuracy, without figures.

I745.screening_reason: Physical activity prediction, not student mental health
I745.summary_en: Proposes WeMoD to predict daily step counts from multimodal wearable and mobile data collected in the wild. It achieves an MAE of 1,930 steps, reduced to 1,908 with personalization.

I746.summary_en: Proposes HDEF-SMBPA, a hybrid ensemble combining XGBoost for behavioral features and CNN for text sentiment and deception, with SHAP, to detect social media addiction and deceptive psychological behavior among students. It reaches 94.2% accuracy and ROC-AUC 0.97, without describing the data.

I747.screening_reason: International environmental agreements, not mental health
I747.summary_en: Uses mathematical modelling and game theory to analyze the dynamics of citizens' attitudes toward climate change and their effect on environmental agreements. Surveys and machine learning are mentioned without detailed results.

I748.summary_en: Predicts early depression in 12,617 Indian undergraduates (Kaggle dataset plus a 2025 survey) with three heterogeneous ensembles (MANN, LogitBoost, WSRF) and repeated cross-validation. WSRF performs best (accuracy 0.9829; test AUC 0.921).

I749.summary_en: Predicts eco-anxiety in medical students by integrating climate exposure, academic pressure and mental health measures (GAD-7, CES-D) with a hybrid RF-BERT model. It achieves 93% accuracy and AUC 0.93.

I750.summary_en: Studies spatial variability in machine learning thermal comfort prediction with 512 primary school students in five naturally ventilated school buildings. Prediction accuracy varies by up to 71% across buildings.

I751.screening_reason: AI in early childhood and elderly education, not mental health
I751.summary_en: Discusses the use of AI in education for young children and elderly people, including benefits and ethical challenges. No data or results are described.

I752.summary_en: Implements a student psychological crisis early warning system fusing video (facial expressions), audio and social media text with DeepFace, ECAPA-TDNN, Transformer and BERT. In a pilot deployment it identifies crises with 91.4% accuracy and a reduced false alarm rate.

I753.screening_reason: No data analytics or ML applied; literature-based analysis
I753.summary_en: Analyzes, based on the literature, how new media characteristics (fragmented reading, passive acceptance, over-dependence) cause learning burnout in undergraduates. No data analysis is reported.

I754.screening_reason: Campus crime analysis, not mental health
I754.summary_en: Introduces a hybrid LLM-RAG system with query routing for interactive analysis of York University campus incident reports. Gemma3:1B and Deepseek-r1:1.5B give reliable grounded answers in a qualitative benchmark.

I755.summary_en: Classifies CTG recordings of 1,548 healthy and 1,548 IUGR fetuses from a Naples hospital with machine learning models. MLP and AdaBoost perform best overall, with Random Forest also among the top models.

I756.summary_en: Compares ten supervised classifiers on a student depression dataset (502 instances, 11 attributes) and tunes four of them (KNN, SVM, LR, AdaBoost) with grid search, random search and Bayesian optimization. No performance figures are reported.

I757.screening_reason: Outcome is diagnosis of problem behaviors; link to mental health is partial
I757.summary_en: Proposes KnowSTU, an assistant that fine-tunes an LLM with QLoRA and adds RAG to diagnose students' problem behaviors from a dataset of annotated real-world dialogue cases. It outperforms baseline LLMs and shows strong acceptance in a teacher study.

I758.screening_reason: Sleep stage detection, not about students
I758.summary_en: Classifies sleep stages from polysomnography data using statistical features, classifiers and stability selection. LightGBM achieves 91.92% accuracy and AUC 98.43%.

I759.summary_en: Discusses how AI can improve academics' well-being and job satisfaction by automating tasks and reducing workplace stress. No data or analytical method are described.

I760.screening_reason: Physical common diseases, not mental health
I760.summary_en: Proposes a BiLSTM-based system to predict common diseases in students from Kaggle health data with physiological and medical parameters. It achieves 98.7% accuracy and an F1-score of 97.5%.

I761.summary_en: Predicts patient satisfaction with indoor environmental quality in a Jordanian hospital from self-reports and environmental monitoring using SVM and KNN. Linear-kernel SVM with C = 0.01 gives the highest accuracy.

I762.summary_en: Explores prospects and obstacles of quantum computing in fog environments for forecasting and university-level education. No data or results are reported.

I763.screening_reason: Green campus sustainability, not mental health
I763.summary_en: Proposes an IoT-based smart green campus system that collects sensor data and uses machine learning predictions to support sustainability decisions. No quantitative results are reported.

I764.summary_en: Classifies students' stress levels in relation to menstrual cycle irregularities with SVM and decision tree after SMOTE balancing. SVM performs best (96.91% with the menstrual variable) and final-year students show the highest, medium stress level.

I765.summary_en: Predicts student stress from biosignals and about 20 psychological, physiological, social, environmental and academic features with several models (deep learning, GLM, RF, gradient boosted trees, decision tree, SVM). The deep learning model performs best, without reported metrics.

I766.summary_en: Plans the use of multimodal earables for stress monitoring, silent speech and activity recognition in a manufacturing environment with machine learning. No results are reported yet.

I767.best_result: Balanced accuracy 69-84% (with contextual and trait data)
I767.summary_en: Detects state social anxiety in 46 undergraduates with elevated trait social anxiety during Zoom interactions using Empatica E4 biobehavioral features, mixed-effect logistic regression and leave-one-subject-out ML. Balanced accuracy is 59% with sensors alone and rises to 69-84% when contextual and trait data are added.

I768.summary_en: Develops a smartwatch-like IoT device measuring HR, EDA, BVP and temperature to monitor students' stress during exams, evaluated on a public dataset, with a deep learning model for stress level. Signal estimation errors are low (MAE 0.512), but stress classification performance is not reported.

I769.screening_reason: Sample not explicitly described as students
I769.summary_en: Predicts a composite mood index (anxiety, depression, stress) from resting-state fMRI functional connectivity using an autoencoder and Gaussian process regression, motivated by undergraduate populations. R² reaches 0.60 at baseline and 0.81 post-intervention; K-means identifies mood groups and the Exercise+Smart group improves.

I770.summary_en: Develops a cognitive load detector from blood volume pulse to time surveys for cancer patients. Personalized 1D CNNs on raw BVP outperform personalized SVMs.

I771.summary_en: Reports lessons learned deploying an edge-to-cloud platform on AWS for elderly health and well-being, with sensor data visualized on a web interface. Average response time is about 7 seconds.

I772.screening_reason: SDG classification of publications, not mental health
I772.summary_en: Proposes a RAG framework (ChromaDB and GPT-4) for multi-label SDG classification of 13,511 Telkom University publication titles. It reaches 80% accuracy versus 65% for keyword-based classification.

I773.summary_en: Examines the impact of toxic leadership and related factors on turnover intention of university ICT staff. Data and methods are not described.

I774.screening_reason: AI in foreign language learning, not mental health
I774.summary_en: Briefly reviews recent implementations of AI in second language learning. No quantitative findings are reported.

I775.summary_en: Diagnoses Parkinson's disease from 195 voice recordings (UCI) with ML models, RandomizedSearchCV tuning and ADASYN. SVC with RSCV performs best (97% accuracy, F1 93%).

I776.summary_en: Predicts a person's lifestyle status from over 15,000 records with 22 features using LSTM, ANN, CNN and SVM combined in a weighted-average ensemble. The ensemble reaches 94.51% accuracy.

I777.best_result: AdaBoost, LGBM and ExtraTrees accuracy 100% (blood tests)
I777.summary_en: Predicts anemia from blood test and eye conjunctiva image datasets from India and Bangladesh with ML models. AdaBoost, LGBM and ExtraTrees reach 100% on blood tests and LGBM and Perceptron 97.61% on eye images.

I778.summary_en: Proposes a camera-based patient monitoring system using multi-feature descriptors and a classifier on the ETRIActivity3D and NTU-RGB-D datasets. It achieves 87.5% and 89.5% accuracy, respectively.

I779.screening_reason: Main outcome is academic performance (GPA); statistical analysis only
I779.summary_en: Examines the relationship between sleep behavior and GPA in undergraduates using a questionnaire, correlation, linear regression and t-tests. Sleep hours correlate strongly with GPA (r = 0.96) and explain 61% of its variance; insomnia is associated with lower GPA.

I780.screening_reason: Teaching recommendation system, not mental health
I780.summary_en: Proposes a deep learning recommendation system for a vocational clothing major using an autoencoder and BART on the Tex atlas dataset. It reaches 93.67% accuracy, outperforming BERT.

I781.screening_reason: Participants from hospital and university settings; not explicitly students
I781.summary_en: Develops a low-cost wearable EEG device with a pretrained EEG foundation model (EEGPT) for real-time stress monitoring, tested on 100 participants (50 high-stress, 50 controls) from hospital and university settings. It achieves 89.5% accuracy, F1 0.89 and AUC 0.94.

I782.summary_en: Proposes an ensemble of artificial neural networks to detect early signs of anxiety, depression and physical and psychological disturbances linked to burnout in university students, using a questionnaire applied to 93 persons in Valparaiso. It reports good accuracy and few false negatives, without figures.

I783.summary_en: Predicts faculty emotions and job satisfaction from facial expressions with a hybrid CNN-SVM model on Kaggle datasets. It reaches 97.6% accuracy, outperforming CNN (93.8%) and SVM (89.2%).

I784.summary_en: Presents ISABELA, an IoT platform predicting academic performance of 61 students from smartphone passive sensing and self-reported behavioral and emotional data. XGBoost and AdaBoost reach up to 79% accuracy.

I785.summary_en: Predicts electronic gadget addiction in students from surveys, screen-time devices and self-assessment scales (SAS, IAT labels) with a hybrid 1D CNN-BiLSTM model with attention. It reaches 96.7% accuracy, outperforming RF (88.6%) and SVM (90.1%).

I786.screening_reason: Mentor-mentee matching system; mental health not measured
I786.summary_en: Proposes a recommendation algorithm to match mentors and mentees based on learning styles, interests and goals, aiming to improve mental health and life satisfaction. No data or results are reported.

I787.screening_reason: Air quality prediction, not mental health
I787.summary_en: Predicts the air quality index for Mumbai using SARMA combined with SVM and KNN on six months of data. Only the minimum RMSE is mentioned, without figures.

I788.screening_reason: General emotion detection system; students only as an application example
I788.summary_en: Proposes a real-time emotion detection system using an Emotiv EEG headset, ESP-32 and machine learning, with possible classroom applications. No data or results are reported.

I789.screening_reason: Outcome is physical discomfort from coffee consumption, not mental health
I789.summary_en: Predicts perceived convenience or inconvenience of coffee consumption in 200 Indonesian university students using Random Forest and XGBoost with 5-fold cross-validation. Random Forest reaches 87%; health complaints, academic stress and staying up late are the main predictors.

I790.screening_reason: Industry and education 5.0, not mental health
I790.summary_en: Analyzes interconnections between industry, education and society toward 5.0 through literature and document analysis and a case study. No analytical results are reported.

I791.summary_en: Reviews approaches to address privacy policy challenges, identifying machine-readable languages, machine learning and other approaches. Machine learning is the growing trend with the highest accuracy.

I792.summary_en: Predicts stress levels of nurses with possibilistic fuzzy c-means segmentation followed by Chameleon Swarm classification on a benchmark dataset. It reports higher accuracy without figures.

I793.summary_en: Distills a fine-tuned BERT teacher into DistilBERT, TinyBERT and ALBERT for postpartum depression screening on a public psychiatrist-annotated Twitter dataset. DistilBERT and TinyBERT approach teacher accuracy (> 0.95) with smaller size and latency.

I794.screening_reason: No data analytics or ML applied
I794.summary_en: Describes the design and deployment of the ScarletWell wellness widget in the Rutgers University portal for students, faculty and staff. Analytics and chatbots are only future directions.

I795.screening_reason: Air quality monitoring, not mental health
I795.summary_en: Proposes an indoor air quality monitoring system for educational campuses, tested at the PIET campus in Panipat. No quantitative results are reported.

I796.screening_reason: Speech segmentation for English teaching, not mental health
I796.summary_en: Designs a transfer learning speech segmentation model based on a modified VGG-Net with residual units for multimedia English classrooms. It claims effectiveness without metrics.

I797.summary_en: Develops a stacked SVM model for preliminary screening of dysthymia using behavioral data from 98 undergraduates. It achieves 85.74% accuracy, outperforming single-kernel SVM and other classifiers.

I798.screening_reason: Focus on security and AI governance architecture; no data analysis
I798.summary_en: Presents a standards-driven security and AI governance framework for 6G edge wearable digital twin networks supporting privacy-preserving student mental health monitoring on campuses. It proposes benchmark KPIs without empirical results.

I799.summary_en: Presents Sparkle Edu, an online learning application with stress detection from facial emotions and drowsiness, an AI mental health therapist with voice-to-text input and course recommendations. No data or results are reported.

I800.screening_reason: Outcome is e-mentoring effectiveness, not mental health
I800.summary_en: Predicts e-mentoring effectiveness from five variables (including psychological-emotional support) using structural equation modelling. Academic support is the strongest predictor and digital competence is not significant.

I801.summary_en: Detects language anxiety in 323 written responses of Telkom University students from open-ended questionnaires, comparing fine-tuned BERT and TF-IDF SVM with oversampling. BERT performs best (85%) versus SVM (78%).

I802.summary_en: Describes data collection strategies for building ML models to predict injuries in gymnastics. No model results are reported.

I803.summary_en: Presents a digital Mandala painting therapy system that uses image processing and statistical methods to compute a parent-child relationship quality index, tested in a three-week study with 88 university students. The experimental group shows a significant PCRQI improvement (p < 0.01) and a 23.5% increase in the Happiness Index.

I804.summary_en: Introduces a Pursuit Regularity Index from videonystagmography for Parkinson's disease detection using a Tunisian hospital dataset. Adding it to ML models improves accuracy, without figures.

I805.screening_reason: Descriptive discussion without data or analytical method
I805.summary_en: Discusses stress among hostel students and existing IoT and embedded tools for stress detection. No data, method or results are reported.

I806.summary_en: Proposes a dual-granularity text model fusing question-answer and PHQ-8 symptom features from clinical interviews for depression detection on DAIC-WOZ. It achieves 79% accuracy and F1 75%.

I807.best_result: LR, SVC, NB, DT and RF accuracy 79%
I807.summary_en: Predicts Reels video addiction from age, gender, platform use and usage behaviors with six classifiers. Most models reach 79% accuracy and KNN 71%.

I808.screening_reason: General review of anxiety detection; students noted only as a limitation
I808.summary_en: Systematic review of 51 studies (2010-2025) on anxiety detection using physiological sensing and machine learning. EDA and HRV are the most consistent biomarkers and multimodal fusion generally outperforms unimodal approaches.

I809.summary_en: Detects depression from 14 days of smartphone logs and questionnaire answers of 38 university students with an underbagging ensemble combining undersampling. It achieves a sensitivity of 0.84 and a G-mean of 0.70.

I810.screening_reason: Sentiment toward online learning, not mental health
I810.summary_en: Analyzes sentiment of 8,976 tweets about online learning during COVID-19 with TF-IDF, SVM and ANN. ANN performs best (81.97% accuracy).

I811.screening_reason: Main outcome is learning in dyslexia and dyscalculia; emotion recognition is secondary
I811.summary_en: Presents LexAyudha, an AI platform using CNNs, RNNs and emotion recognition to adapt learning for adolescents with dyslexia and dyscalculia in Sri Lanka. Initial tests show improvements in reading fluency, comprehension and motivation, without metrics.

I812.summary_en: Proposes a multi-sensor AI framework (HRV, EDA, EEG, SpO2, blood pressure) for real-time stress prediction in high-stress settings including students. No data or results are reported.

I813.screening_reason: Outcome is sleep quality and behavioral health indicators, not explicitly mental health
I813.summary_en: Presents a public dataset of smartwatch and smartphone measures of physical activity, sleep and screen time from 24 undergraduates, labelled with sleep quality and behavioral health indicators. Four baseline classifiers are implemented, without reported figures.

I814.summary_en: Designs a wearable watch acquiring PPG heart rate and EDA to monitor stress, extracting instantaneous frequency features and classifying with Bi-LSTM. It achieves 99.38% accuracy and F1 98.88% on the collected dataset.

I815.summary_en: Compares ML models (DT, GB, RF, SVM, KNN, SGD, AdaBoost, XGBoost) for fetal health classification on 2,126 CTG records from UCI. The best model and metrics are not stated.

I816.screening_reason: Target is parenting style; mental health variables used as predictors
I816.summary_en: Classifies parenting styles from 2,206 survey responses of school, college and university students covering stress, anxiety, depression, attachment and anger, using SVM, KNN, RF, XGBoost and decision tree. RF and XGBoost achieve the highest accuracy (87.30%).

I817.summary_en: Predicts employability of 500 electronics engineering graduates with an ensemble classifier, association rule mining and permutation feature importance. The RF-SVM-NB ensemble reaches 93.33% and grit is strongly linked to employability.

I818.summary_en: Classifies stress and depression levels of medical professionals (CES-D) with a clustering-based Multilayered Progressive Formulation method. It reaches 86% accuracy and F1 0.86.

I819.summary_en: Proposes a generative AI job-matching platform for a rural Indian village based on participatory appraisal and human-centered design. No evaluation results are reported.
